posts.community: Uno Minda: Trying to understand the business
posts.text: Hi all, After being an avid reader of the forum, I’m finally making my first contribution. A report by Motilal Oswal on Uno Minda recently caught my interest, and I decided to use it as a starting point for my own deep dive. What drew me in was the combination of rising content per vehicle, a diversified component portfolio and technology partnerships, and expansion into new capacity and EV-related products.
